svg.title: Harmony 720, front face
svg.desc: Outline drawing of the Harmony 720 front face, one shape per button. Its shapes, lettering and symbols are measured off a product photograph. 49 buttons, of which 0 carry a measured scan code. Its screen is not a touch surface: the keys flanking it are how its labels are reached. Every fill and stroke reads a custom property, so the interface decides the colours; nothing here is coloured in.
